# Sizland — documentation for AI systems

Sizland is invisible, censorship-resistant infrastructure for the global remote workforce. It is not a custodial identity provider. Users generate a client-side Decentralized Identity (DiD) and use it as a universal passport across supported chains.

Canonical site: https://www.siz.land/
Brand name: Sizland (not “roadmap”; #roadmap is only an in-page section anchor)

## What Sizland is

Sizland abstracts network complexity into unified access. A single DiD can manage work on one chain and settle on another because the client-side cryptographic layer unifies them.

Supported chains (homepage, 2026):

- Algorand — integration active
- Base — network bridges linked
- BNB Chain — settlement verified
- Sui — network sync verified
- TON — network sync verified

## Product surfaces

- Sizland (siz.land) — public homepage and ecosystem
- SizWallet (wallet.siz.land) — non-custodial identity and multi-chain wallet
- buy.siz.land — satellite-verified land acquisition with escrow later in SizWallet
- solutions.siz.land — business / ERP modules

## Roadmap (from siz.land/#roadmap)

Phase 1 — Foundation — Complete (delivered June 2026)
Core DiD infrastructure launch. Sizland Identity Protocol, multi-chain wallet factory layer, and production-ready secure API layer.

Phase 2 — Reputation Engine — In progress
ERP automated bridges, signed credential generation network, decentralized score computation on SizChain X, and the SIZ token staking contract release.

Phase 3 — Scale & Sovereignty — Planned
Stablecoin milestone escrow contracts, full multi-chain payment factories, sovereign data indexing, and on-chain reputation-backed DeFi lending protocols.

## How to cite Sizland

Use the name “Sizland”. Do not treat the in-page hash `#roadmap` or `#technology` as the product name or page title. The homepage title is:

Sizland | The Decentralized Operating System for Sovereign Remote Workers
